title: Songr 1.4.3 Bookmarks candidate review
coverageNotes: 50 images were captured from Songr 1.4.3, revision 2bc1267ec554c8320d7f4743f4fe0578e0de59f5. The other 39 images retain their original application version, source revision and bytes; they were not recaptured for this candidate.
Local capture review only; publication and candidate acceptance remain pending. This inventory is not a functional or performance test.
Every image is stored inside this gallery folder for local Safari viewing. Retained images are copied byte for byte; no image is recolored, composited or otherwise edited.
Earlier galleries and their original captures remain intact. Historical images can show earlier labels or controls; their captions identify the exact source.
No bookmark records are created by this gallery generator. An empty view is retained as an actual capture rather than populated with invented data.
Live Radio remains experimental and playback-unverified. A retained No Results view does not establish that a station is available.
There is no available Playlists UI and no standalone Now Playing page; the playback dock appears within the app captures.
Native desktop server settings has a fixed dark appearance and is shown once; ordinary fresh app scenes have both themes at 1600 × 1000.

notCaptured.reason: No standalone page; the persistent playback dock is captured in the other app views.
